task.title: Aligning the MC-5000 Spindle Using Laser Calibration
task.shortdesc: Perform precision spindle alignment on the MC-5000 VMC using the Haimer Ziegler laser alignment system to ensure concentricity within ±3 μm.

ul.li: Ensure the machine is in Maintenance Mode (key switch position M).
Verify the machine has been cooled down for at least 30 minutes after last operation.

Confirm all safety interlocks (see .
Prepare the following tools:
Haimer Ziegler laser alignment kit (P/N: HZ-5000-KIT)
Torque wrench (5–50 Nm, calibrated)
Cleaning solvent and lint-free wipes
Dial indicator with magnetic base (resolution: 1 μm)
Review the machine's maintenance log for previous alignment history.

ol.li: Power off the main disconnect switch and lockout/tagout (LOTO).
Open the front door and clean the spindle taper using solvent and lint-free wipes.
Inspect the spindle taper for nicks, scoring, or wear. Do not proceed if damage is visible.
Mount the laser emitter (HZ-5000-EMIT) into the spindle taper and tighten by hand.

step.stepresult: The machine is prepared and the laser emitter is seated in the spindle taper.

step.cmd: Mount the laser target assembly on the worktable.

ol.li: Mount the HZ-5000-TARGET bracket using two M16 T-nuts at position X=200, Y=150.
Align the target face perpendicular to the spindle axis using the built-in bubble level.
Tighten the bracket bolts to 35 Nm using the torque wrench.

step.stepresult: The laser target is rigidly mounted on the worktable.

ol.li: Power on the machine and enter Maintenance Mode at the HMI.
Rotate the spindle manually to 0 degrees reference position.
On the HZ-5000 controller, press Start Measurement.
Read the displayed X and Y offset values on the controller screen.

step.stepresult: The laser alignment controller displays the spindle offset in both X and Y axes.

step.cmd: Adjust the spindle head based on measurement results.

strow.stentry: No adjustment needed. Proceed to final verification.
Slight adjustment recommended using fine-adjustment screws (1/4 turn increments).
Full mechanical alignment required. Refer to .

info.note: Never exceed 1/2 turn on any single adjustment screw without repeating the measurement. Overtightening can strain the spindle housing.

step.stepresult: The spindle head is adjusted to within the tolerance range.

ol.li: Repeat the laser measurement (Step 3) to confirm X and Y offsets.
Record the final offset values in the maintenance log (HMI: MaintenanceLogSpindle Alignment).
Remove the laser emitter and target assembly.
Perform a 5-minute test run at 3,000 RPM, monitoring spindle vibration (< 0.5 mm/s RMS).

step.stepresult: Alignment is verified and recorded in the system.

ul.li: Close and tag the maintenance log entry.
Return the Haimer Ziegler kit to the tool crib (verify all components present).
If the next scheduled maintenance is within 50 hours, proceed to perform the ball screw lubrication procedure.
